svg.title: Three ways into MediaStack
svg.desc: A browser or app reaches Jellyfin and Seerr only through Nginx Proxy Manager over HTTPS, with a Let’s Encrypt certificate. The router forwards TCP 80 and 443 to the proxy, UDP 51820 to WireGuard, and TCP/UDP 6881 to qBittorrent peers. Admin ports are not forwarded. A WireGuard profile receives one firewall tier per device: the whole LAN, the server, the containers, or Jellyfin only, as for a relative’s TV. At home, devices reach all services and admin pages directly by host address and service port. With the default admin-port filter, only private, loopback and Tailscale sources reach admin ports; the DOCKER-USER firewall chain drops other sources even if a port is forwarded by mistake. The chain is installed before Docker starts. If it cannot be applied, Docker does not start.
svg.text: Also forwarded: 6881 TCP/UDP → qBittorrent peers. Admin ports stay unforwarded.
Host address + service port · no router forwarding

g.text: Other sources dropped, even if a port is forwarded.
DOCKER-USER · installed before Docker; failure prevents startup
